$comment: Rock files whose logic the builder ports or depends on, with a fingerprint (SHA-256 of the text, line endings normalized) as of the last review. check-rock-lock.js compares them with Rock on GitHub. A section is the text from 'from' up to 'to', for files that are large and change for unrelated reasons.
